Reading order: running head, main column top to bottom, then left-edge margin text.; Left: a narrow column of printed text at the left edge, in bold type, running vertically with hyphenated line ends; the rest of the page is blank except for a signature-style mark and a catchword-like heading "Ad" at upper right.

main_text.p: omnes dei actiones, omnia sunt vestra, i. vestri iuris, vos eorum legitimi domini & possessores estis, vestrae salutis ministri sunt.

Verf. 23. Vos autem Christi. i. Vt creaturae vestrum, sic vos Christi peculium estis: vt illae vobis sic vos Christo subiecti eiusque gloriae procurandae & nomini celebrando creati, redempti, sanctificati & glorificati estis. Idcirco non in creaturis seruis vestris sed in Christo domino vestro & foelicitatis vestrae authore gloriari vos decet. Christus autem dei-Vt creaturae vobis, vos Christo seruatori vestro, sic Christus secundum humanam naturam & assumptum mediatoris officium Dei patre inferior est, ei subiectus, eius gloriae procurandae subordinatus: omnes enim Christi mediatoris actiones ad dei gloriam vt ad vltimum finem referuntur. Similis gradatio habetur infra 11,13. vir mulieris, Christus viri, deus Christi caput.

page.notes: Left-edge column is partly cut and shows only fragments (3., itur, prae-, hoc, ...); not transcribed in full. Some letters in the main column are doubtful, notably "Christus autem dei" and "vltimum". The left-hand column is a fragment of the cut-off page, shown only as its line ends; the words are heavily cut and cannot be reliably read beyond these fragments. The word "Ad" at upper right is a fragment of a heading or catchword and is uncertain.
